examples.pie: príHe me ḱludʰí kéh₂ilom mē h₂éḱh₃s. sh₁méney h₁wésu ǵr̥h₂nóm dʰh₁dʰí. h₁íd wr̥míbʰos ḱéle. h₁yós séh₁mn̥ h₁ḗdti só ne séh₁yeti. séh₁mn̥ ḱóymōy h₂éh₂usom. ḱód memn̥dʰí téwe-kʷe ǵénh₁mn̥h₂ gʷíh₃woyh₁t.
examples.en: Hear me, friend: do not eat up the whole. Set aside the good grain for seed. Hide it from the worms. He who eats the seed, he does not sow. Seed is gold to the household. Remember this, and may your children live.

examples.pie: kʷŕ̥mey h₁éǵʰs h₁néwn̥ wr̥míbʰis ḱóm gʷh₂dʰí. kʷŕ̥mey snéh₁wōr mosgʰṓd ih₂dʰí. wórmey mḗms sn̥h₁wénbʰos h₁idʰí. nu skéwHtim mémsos sérpe. kʷŕ̥mey soksóm skuHtéys litdʰí. nu kʷŕ̥mey h₂én mr̥dʰí h₂éti-kʷe mē gʷéms.
examples.en: Go out, worm, with nine worms! Go, worm, from the marrow into the sinews! Go, worm, from the sinews into the flesh! Now crawl from the flesh into the skin! Go away, worm, from the skin into the stone! Now die there, worm, and do not come back!

root.gloss: to hold, restrain; to take, seize

examples.pie: kʷíd léǵesi? wékʷmn̥ toy léǵoh₂. tód wékʷmn̥ h₁wésu? h₁íd h₁wésu h₁ésyo-kʷe wékʷesh₂ priHéh₂.
examples.en: What are you reading? I am reading your message. Is the message good? It is good, and its words are dear.

examples.pie: h₂réh₁ǵtor me h₁uHdʰí. kʷíd wéḱsi? swesrés moy dṓm h₂isḱóh₂. dómn̥s ne spéḱyoh₂ wékʷmn̥h₂ spéḱyoh₂.
examples.en: Helper, help me! What do you want? I am seeking my sister's house. I do not see houses; I see messages.

source.name: coinage
source.note: Result noun in -mn̥ 'what is spoken' from wekʷ- (as ǵnéh₃mn̥ 'sign', ḱléwmn̥ 'hearing'); Ved. vácas-/vácana- for the sense 'utterance'.

examples.pie: móri h₁éymi. stéygʰesi neh₂wéh₁-wē h₁éysi? neh₂wéh₁ moy bʰréh₂tr̥h₁ ḱóm h₁éymi. mréys bʰebʰóyh₂th₂e? mréys ne bʰebʰóyh₂h₂e. n̥syéh₁s.
examples.en: I am going to the sea. Are you walking, or going by boat? I am going by boat with my brother. Are you afraid of the sea? I am not afraid of the sea. May you come home safe!

examples.pie: dyéw nos ph₂ter stéh₂dʰh₁om ph₂sdʰí. ǵʰwḗr h₂ówins mē lm̥bʰyéh₁t gʰóstis-wē h₁éḱwons mē stéh₂yoyh₁t. nu h₂éǵroy h₁édih₁t tr̥pyéh₁t-kʷe. nu nos wékʷos ḱludʰí.
examples.en: Father Sky, protect our herd! May the beast not seize the sheep, nor a stranger steal the horses. May it eat in the pasture, and may it be sated. Hear our word!

examples.pie: túH wĺ̥kʷos. dh₂pnóm gʷr̥h₃és. túH h₂ówis ne kʷid h₁ḗds trémsi-kʷe. h₁ddʰí wĺ̥kʷos-wē te gʷr̥h₃ḗti. wĺ̥kʷoybʰos ne dedwóyh₂e. nu sddʰí péh₃tlōd-kʷe moy ph₃dʰí.
examples.en: You are a wolf! You devoured the feast. And you are a sheep: you ate nothing, and you tremble! Eat, or the wolf will devour you! I am not afraid of wolves! Then sit down and drink from my cup.
